nodes.label: graphify Skill
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder of code, docs, papers, images, or video into a persistent knowledge graph with community detection and an EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS audit trail, producing interactive HTML, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and a plain-language GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: Existing-Graph Fast Path
nodes.source_location: ## What You Must Do When Invoked
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json exists and the request is a natural-language codebase question rather than an explicit rebuild, skip Steps 1-5 entirely and run graphify query immediately — no detect, no corpus-size gate, no narrowing prompt. The graph is already built, so use it.

nodes.label: Graphify Python Interpreter Detection
nodes.rationale: Probes uv tool dir, then pipx local venvs, then the active env, saving the resolved interpreter to graphify-out/.graphify_python so every later step runs through the Python that actually has graphify. A subcommand guard re-resolves it when the sidecar is missing.

nodes.label: No API Key Required
nodes.rationale: Code is extracted structurally with no LLM and no key, so a code-only corpus needs nothing. Semantic extraction uses Gemini only if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set; otherwise the host agent itself is the LLM. graphify never reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY — prompting for one is a misread of the skill.

nodes.label: Part A Structural AST Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and free: collect_files + extract over detected code files into .graphify_ast.json. Runs in parallel with semantic subagents since the two operate on different file types, saving 5-15s on large corpora.

nodes.label: Part B Semantic Subagent Extraction
nodes.rationale: Docs, papers, and images are chunked 20-25 files at a time (one image per chunk, same-directory files grouped) and dispatched as parallel general-purpose subagents in a single message. Explore-type agents are forbidden because they are read-only and silently drop results by being unable to write chunk files. A code-only corpus skips Part B but must still write an empty semantic file so the Part C merge has its input.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Cache entries are attributed to the extraction prompt file, so a graphify upgrade that changes the prompt re-extracts old entries while unchanged prompts replay theirs. The same SPEC_PATH must be passed to both the check and the save, or a write lands where the next read will not look. The cache file is deleted rather than left stale when there are no hits.

nodes.label: Community Detection and Labeling
nodes.rationale: Step 4 clusters, scores cohesion, finds god nodes and surprising connections with placeholder labels; Step 5 replaces them with 2-5 word plain-language names, regenerates the report and questions, and re-exports graph.json so nodes carry the curated community_name.

nodes.label: graph.json Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: The empty-graph check runs before any write so a failed extraction cannot clobber a good graph, and to_json refuses to write when the new graph has fewer nodes than the existing one. GRAPH_REPORT.md and the analysis sidecar are written only after the graph actually lands, so they never describe a graph that graph.json does not contain.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only diagnostic before labeling that surfaces edge collapse, dangling and missing endpoints, and self-loops — the silent-corruption modes of incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches. It never aborts, but any warning must be surfaced in the final summary per the Honesty Rules.

nodes.label: Manifest Stamping and Cost Tracker
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced output are stamped; a detected doc whose chunk failed must stay unstamped so the next --update re-queues it, otherwise its content is lost forever. Dispatched-but-unstamped files have their stale semantic hash cleared, and the raw corpus (not the filtered subset) is passed as scan_corpus so newly excluded files are dropped rather than read as deletions. Manifest keys are relativized to the scan root so they stay portable across clones.

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS when unsure), never skip the corpus-check warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion behind symbols, and never render HTML for a graph over 5,000 nodes without warning. The audit trail is the product's credibility.
